_note: On-TV mode keeps its settings on the TV. Change them on the phone at http://<tv-ip>:5400/setup, or POST this shape (all fields optional) to /api/settings with your phone's token.

scores._note: Game-day score bugs (docs/SCORES.md). MLB from MLB's own feed; the NBA from ESPN's public scoreboard, which is not an official feed (leave the nba team out if you would rather not). A channel's number and link are yours to fill in; 0 and "" mean not filled in.

watching._note: Keep watching from what was really watched on the TV (docs/KEEP-WATCHING.md). Nothing is listened to until one permission is given over ADB. lookup true asks JustWatch for a picture when an app gives none, and for the show when an app names only the episode (and TVmaze, when the episode is named only by its date); that sends names of what was watched, and of previews the app played, there. Leave exclude out to keep the built-in list of apps left out (music, YouTube, live TV).
